purpose: Structural/timing evidence only. Do not copy official exercise scripts or audio into authored videos.

audio.analysis: Local FFprobe, FFmpeg silencedetect at -40dB for at least 1.5 seconds, and cached unprompted faster-whisper-small.
limitations: Detected quiet intervals include threshold-dependent room noise, breaths, fades and padding; they are not exact authored pause durations.
The primary ASR hallucinated repeated words over some silent/low-level regions and missed part of the second instruction; do not use those ASR timestamps as an exact speech clock.
Part 2 per-message repetition is supported by the successive recognized recordings, but this is not human listening certification.
Approximate replay gaps are five seconds; most response gaps are ten seconds, with a shorter observed task-11 gap. Do not flatten these observations into an asserted uniform official rule.
The official audio is retained only as a local research reference outside the authored delivery. New videos must use newly approved text and synthesized recordings.

proposed_guided_practice.status: Pending user approval. Longer replay/answer pauses than the observed model; no claim of official uninterrupted exam timing.
